SELECT
  s.store_key,
  s.store_name,
  s.location_code,
  s.country_code,
  s.state,
  s.open_date,
  s.close_date,
  s.status_annotation,
  s.square_metres,
  (
    s.location_code = -1
  ) AS matches_sentinel,
  (
    s.store_name = 'Online store'
  ) AS matches_name,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
    WHERE
      l.store_key = s.store_key
  ) AS lines_on_fact,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT l.channel)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
    WHERE
      l.store_key = s.store_key
  ) AS distinct_channels_on_fact,
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(l.net_amount)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
    WHERE
      l.store_key = s.store_key
  ) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
WHERE
  s.location_code = -1
  OR LOWER(s.store_name) LIKE '%online%'
  OR LOWER(s.store_name) LIKE '%web%'
  OR LOWER(s.store_name) LIKE '%internet%'
ORDER BY
  s.store_key
